verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Yubico exposes a public YubiEnterprise REST API whose documentation is live at console.yubico.com/apidocs/. However, the evidence only confirms a human-readable docs page, not a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. All probed OpenAPI and Swagger paths on docs.yubico.com returned 404, and the docs are described as human-oriented HTML only.
